mapper.sql: select d.*, i.title as itemTitle, i.price as itemPrice, (select img.image_data from item_image img where img.item_id = d.item_id order by img.sort_no limit 1) as itemCover, b.nickname as buyerNickname, s.nickname as sellerNickname from deal d left join item i on d.item_id = i.id left join `user` b on d.buyer_id = b.id left join `user` s on d.seller_id = s.id
mapper.insert: insert into deal (item_id, buyer_id, seller_id, deal_price, source, source_id, status) values (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{dealPrice}, #{source}, #{sourceId}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: where d.item_id = #{itemId} and d.status = 'PENDING' order by d.id desc limit 1
where d.item_id = #{itemId} and d.status = 'COMPLETED' order by d.id desc limit 1

where d.status = 'COMPLETED' and (d.buyer_id = #{userId} or d.seller_id = #{userId}) and not exists(select 1 from review r where r.item_id = d.item_id and r.reviewer_id = #{userId}) order by d.completed_at desc
mapper.update: update deal set status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update deal set status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
